verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is an API-first scraping SaaS, so an in-product assistant is a fair question. The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant you can delegate tasks to. `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` are natural-language extraction parameters on individual API calls, the ChatGPT and Gemini endpoints are data APIs for querying those models, and the MCP server serves external agents. None of these is an assistant inside the product that accepts and carries out delegated tasks.
